# Huruf (حروف)

> Huruf is a premium Arabic word puzzle game for Android and iOS. Players swipe
> across a letter wheel to form real Arabic words across 500 hand-tuned levels
> set in 8 illustrated worlds. It doubles as a brain-training and Arabic
> vocabulary game, and includes 62 curated challenges built from authentic
> Arabic proverbs, Gulf sayings, and classical poetry. Free to play, with
> optional in-app point packs. Interface is fully Arabic (Gulf dialect), RTL.

## Key facts

- **Name:** Huruf — Arabic: حروف (means "letters")
- **Genre:** Word puzzle / word game / brain training / educational
- **Platforms:** Android (Google Play), iOS (App Store)
- **Package / bundle ID:** com.huruf.huruf
- **Price:** Free to download and play. Optional in-app purchases: point packs
  from $1.99 to $19.99, plus a one-time $4.99 ad-removal.
- **Language:** Arabic only (Gulf dialect), right-to-left interface
- **Audience:** Arabic speakers, primarily Gulf/GCC (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait,
  Qatar, Bahrain, Oman); also Arabic learners
- **Offline:** The full 500-level campaign and all language challenges work
  offline. Only daily challenge, friends leaderboard and duels need internet.
- **Account:** No sign-up required. Social features create an anonymous profile
  automatically.

## Content scale

- 500 levels across 8 worlds (each world has 62–63 levels)
- Wheels range from 3 to 10 letters; each level has up to 8 target words
- 62 language challenges in 4 categories: Arabic proverbs (22), Gulf proverbs
  (6), classical poetry verses (12), authentic vocabulary (22)
- 9 animated guide characters, one per world plus a main mascot

## Core gameplay

Drag a finger across letters arranged on a circular wheel to build a word. If
the word is one of the level's targets it locks into the grid. Valid words that
aren't targets still count as bonus words and award points. Points buy hints
(reveal a random letter, or reveal a word's first letter). Shuffling the wheel
is always free.

Difficulty rises gradually: every level's word list steps up one letter length
at a time (3 → 4 → 5 …) with no gaps, so the ramp never jumps from a short word
straight to a ten-letter one.

## Social features

- **Daily challenge:** one puzzle per day, identical for every player
  worldwide, playable once, resets at 00:00 UTC. Builds a consecutive-day
  streak.
- **Share result:** a spoiler-free emoji grid (🟩 solved, 🟨 solved with a hint,
  ⬛ missed) shareable as plain text.
- **Friends leaderboard:** add friends with a 6-character text code (no deep
  links). Rank by streak, words solved this week, or total score.
- **Friend duel:** create a room, share a 5-character code, both players solve
  the identical board independently, then results appear side by side.

## Educational and cultural value

Huruf is designed as a vocabulary and mental-agility workout: it exercises
recall, pattern recognition, letter-combination reasoning and sustained focus.
Every word comes from a curated Arabic dictionary and is automatically validated
as formable from its own wheel — there are no invented or machine-generated
words. The challenge modes teach real Arabic proverbs, Gulf folk sayings and
lines of classical Arabic poetry, presented as puzzles to solve rather than text
to read.

## Common questions

**Is Huruf free?** Yes. All 500 levels are free. Point purchases are optional.

**Does it need an account?** No. Play starts immediately; social features create
an anonymous profile with no form to fill in.

**Can it be played offline?** Yes, the entire campaign and challenges. Only the
daily challenge, leaderboard and duels require a connection.

**Is it good for learning Arabic?** It builds vocabulary and reading fluency in
Arabic and teaches authentic proverbs and poetry, but the interface is entirely
in Arabic, so it suits people who can already read Arabic script.

**What dialect does it use?** Gulf Arabic for the guide characters and interface
copy; the puzzle words themselves are Modern Standard Arabic vocabulary.
